claim: In late June 2026 Zscaler ThreatLabz identified Abyssos, a modular C++ RAT with credential theft, file exfiltration, and VNC remote access.
source_title: Abyssos: Technical Analysis of a New Modular RAT

claim: Abyssos uses a custom TCP protocol with AES-GCM encryption and a HELLO| registration string including internal version (e.g. v2.4F).

claim: Abyssos supports HVNC browser session hijacking via Chrome remote debugging port 9222 and Network.setCookie using cloned cookies under %TEMP%\fontconfigs.
source_title: Abyssos: Technical Analysis of a New Modular RAT

claim: Zscaler published two sample SHA-256 values (versions 2.4F and 2.1F) and two C2 IPv4 addresses for Abyssos.
